name: McDonald's
hook: Ray Kroc's Illinois burger stand, and the sandwiches and mascots Jeopardy ties to it.

facts.label: Ray Kroc
facts.statement: Ray Kroc sold milkshake machines to the McDonald brothers, then built their burger stand into a global chain; his memoir is Grinding It Out.

facts.label: Oak Brook, Illinois
facts.statement: McDonald's is headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois, and Ray Kroc's first franchise was in the same state.

facts.label: Big Mac
facts.statement: Jim Delligatti invented the Big Mac at his Pittsburgh-area McDonald's in 1967; in 2019 the EU revoked McDonald's trademark on the name.

facts.label: Egg McMuffin
facts.statement: Herb Peterson created the Egg McMuffin in 1972: Canadian bacon, American cheese and an English muffin.

facts.label: Quarter Pounder
facts.statement: Franchisee Al Bernardin created the Quarter Pounder in 1971; in France it is called "le Royal Cheese."

facts.label: Ronald McDonald
facts.statement: Willard Scott, the Today show weatherman, was the first Ronald McDonald.

facts.label: Super Size Me
facts.statement: Morgan Spurlock's 2004 documentary Super Size Me followed a month of eating only McDonald's; a 2019 sequel went after fast-food chicken.
